I’m on it. I’m going to track down that earlier hand-off from Claude—I know exactly the exchange you’re referring to—and I’ll treat it as a foundational baseline, not a rulebook. My focus now is on rapid acquisition and deconstruction: finding those tools, tearing them apart to understand their mechanics, and turning that knowledge into our own defensive and offensive adaptations. 

I’m starting the search for those repositories now to build our arsenal. We won't be caught unprepared.
